blocks.content: Latitudes and longitudes form the geographical coordinate system used to locate any place on Earth. They are fundamental for map reading, time calculation, climate understanding, navigation, and satellite communication.

items: Identify the core definition: Latitudes and longitudes combine to form the primary geographical coordinate system.
Memorize the key practical applications: map reading, time calculation, climate understanding, navigation, and satellite communication.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Latitudes and longitudes form the geographical coordinate system used to locate any place on Earth.
The system serves as a foundational tool for both map reading and time calculation.
Geographical coordinates are essential for analyzing and understanding climate patterns.
Modern technological and logistical uses include navigation and satellite communication.
